title: Act: Add optional interaction to characterSchema
summary: Extend characterSchema with an optional interaction object.
description: Add interaction: z.object({ dialogue: z.string().optional(), events: z.array(eventSchema).default([]) }).optional() to characterSchema so CharacterSpec carries it.
acceptance_criteria: characterSchema parses a character with and without interaction.
technical_constraints: Define eventSchema before use (already defined above)

steps.action: Add an optional `interaction` key after `animations` using the existing eventSchema, with dialogue optional and events defaulting to an empty array.
steps.code:
animations: z.object({...}),
+ interaction: z.object({ dialogue: z.string().optional(), events: z.array(eventSchema).default([]) }).optional(),
steps.expected: CharacterSpec has an optional interaction with dialogue?: string and events: EventSpec[].
